name: Dynamic Tags for Elementor
author: Mustafa Kamal hossain

sections.description:
Dynamic Tags for Elementor is the ultimate dynamic content toolkit. It enables 100+ custom dynamic tags in Elementor Free, organized into purpose-built groups. When upgraded to Pro, it unlocks 149+ additional premium tags across Post Pro, Media Pro, Author Pro, Site Pro, WooCommerce Pro, ACF Pro, and SCF Pro.

Our advanced caching system with request-scoped memoization for repeated field lookups and product queries, and transient-based admin caching with smart invalidation, delivers faster page rendering and reduced database queries.

Features

  • Post & Archive — Post title, date, content, categories, comments, excerpt, terms, parent, archive titles, and descriptions.
  • Site & Media — Site title, URL, tagline, logo, icon, featured images, and galleries.
  • Author & User — Author details, bio, profile pictures, user roles, capabilities, and profile metrics.
  • Actions & Comments — Dynamic links for lightboxes, off-canvas, reload, and comment forms.
  • WooCommerce — Product price, SKU, stock status, categories, and reviews.
  • ACF & SCF Parity — 13 custom field tags supporting repeaters, galleries, relationships, date-time, maps, and option pages.
  • Pro Version (Upgrade) — Unlocks 149+ premium tags including WooCommerce Pro (34 tags), ACF Pro (34 tags), SCF Pro (34 tags), and the newly categorized WordPress Pro suite: Post Pro (16 tags), Media Pro (6 tags), Author Pro (12 tags), and Site Pro (13 tags).

Use for dynamic text, URLs, images, and conditional outputs in any Elementor Free widget.

Video Tutorial

Dependencies

  • Required: Elementor
  • Optional: Advanced Custom Fields (ACF), Secure Custom Fields (SCF), WooCommerce, WPML, Polylang
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/dynamic-tags-for-elementor.
  2. Activate via Plugins menu.
  3. Open Elementor editor → click Dynamic Tags icon on any supported field → choose a tag.

For quick tag discovery, go to WP Admin → Dynamic Tags → Tag Directory.
sections.faq:
Does this require Elementor Pro?

No. This plugin works exclusively with Elementor Free. All dynamic tags are designed for Elementor Free and do not require a Pro license.

Will this conflict with Elementor Pro tags?

No. DTE tags are registered in separate groups and coexist peacefully with Elementor Pro tags. If you later upgrade to Pro, both tag sets remain available.

Which custom fields and third-party plugins are supported?

DTE supports:
* WooCommerce (Product price, SKU, stock status, categories, ratings, add-to-cart URLs).
* ACF (Advanced Custom Fields) (13 tags including repeaters, galleries, relationships, true/false, taxonomy terms, dates).
* SCF (Secure Custom Fields) (13 tags with feature parity to ACF).
* WPML & Polylang (Automatic language-aware URL filtering).

Can I use these tags in all Elementor widgets?

Most widgets with text, URL, or image fields support dynamic tags (indicated by the small Dynamic Tag icon next to the field).

How do I find a specific tag quickly?

Go to WP Admin → Dynamic Tags → Tag Directory to view a searchable list of all tags grouped by category with descriptions.

Can I register custom dynamic tags?

Yes. DTE provides filters and action hooks for third-party developers, including dynatafo_dynamic_tag_groups and dynatafo_register_dynamic_tags.
sections.changelog:
1.2.8

  • Added: Support for new Post Pro category.
  • Added: Post Reading Time tag that will help to display the reading time of a post.
  • Added: Related Posts Count tag that will help to count the number of posts matching the current post’s category or tag taxonomy.
  • Added: Next Post Title tag that will help to display the title of the next post in sequence.
  • Added: Previous Post Title tag that will help to display the title of the previous post in sequence.
  • Added: Next Post URL tag that will help to display the permalink URL of the next post in sequence.
  • Added: Previous Post URL tag that will help to display the permalink URL of the previous post in sequence.
  • Added: Next Post Thumbnail URL tag that will help to display the featured image URL of the next post.
  • Added: Previous Post Thumbnail URL tag that will help to display the featured image URL of the previous post.
  • Added: Post Word Count tag that will help to display the exact word count of the current post content.
  • Added: Post Character Count tag that will help to display the character count of the current post content.
  • Added: Post Revision Count tag that will help to display the total number of saved revisions for the current post.
  • Added: Post Sticky Status tag that will help to check if the post is set as sticky.
  • Added: Post Password Protected tag that will help to check if the post is password protected.
  • Added: Post Menu Order tag that will help to display the menu order value defined for the current page.
  • Added: Days Since Post Published tag that will help to calculate the number of days since the current post was published.
  • Added: Days Until Event / Date tag that will help to count down the days until a custom target date or meta date field.
  • Added: Support for new Media Pro category.
  • Added: Post Featured Image Alt Text tag that will help to display the alternative text of the featured image.
  • Added: Post Featured Image Caption tag that will help to display the caption of the featured image.
  • Added: Post Featured Image Description tag that will help to display the description of the featured image.
  • Added: Attachment File Size tag that will help to display the file size of a media attachment file.
  • Added: Attachment File Type tag that will help to display the file extension or MIME type of the media attachment.
  • Added: Attachment Dimensions tag that will help to display the width and height of the image attachment.
  • Added: Support for new Author Pro category.
  • Added: Current User First Name tag that will help to display the first name of the currently logged-in user.
  • Added: Current User Last Name tag that will help to display the last name of the currently logged-in user.
  • Added: Logged In Status tag that will help to check if the visitor is logged in.
  • Added: Current User Post Count tag that will help to display the total number of published posts by the logged-in user.
  • Added: Current User Comment Count tag that will help to display the total number of comments by the logged-in user.
  • Added: Current User Nickname tag that will help to display the nickname of the logged-in user.
  • Added: Current User Website URL tag that will help to display the website URL of the logged-in user.
  • Added: Current User Description / Bio tag that will help to display the biographical info of the logged-in user.
  • Added: Current User Meta (Generic) tag that will help to retrieve custom user meta fields of the logged-in user.
  • Added: Author Post Count tag that will help to display the total number of published posts by the post author.
  • Added: Author Registration Date tag that will help to display the registration date of the post author.
  • Added: Author Social Links tag that will help to display social profile links for the post author.
  • Added: Support for new Site Pro category.
  • Added: WordPress Version tag that will help to display the current WordPress version string.
  • Added: PHP Version tag that will help to display the current PHP version string.
  • Added: Site Admin Email tag that will help to display the administrator email address of the site.
  • Added: Site Language tag that will help to display the active site locale code.
  • Added: Site Charset tag that will help to display the site character set encoding.
  • Added: Custom Option Value tag that will help to retrieve any option value from the options table by option name.
  • Added: Theme Name tag that will help to display the name of the active theme.
  • Added: Theme Version tag that will help to display the version of the active theme.
  • Added: Child Theme Name tag that will help to display the active child theme name.
  • Added: Active Plugins Count tag that will help to display the total number of active plugins.
  • Added: Memory Usage tag that will help to display the PHP memory usage details.
  • Added: Server Time Zone tag that will help to display the site’s configured timezone setting.
  • Added: Site Tagline with Fallback tag that will help to display the site tagline with a fallback option.
  • Enhanced: Dynamic Tag Directory category count calculation and chip hiding based on selected license filter (Free/Pro).
  • Update: UI updated for better layout spacing in the Dynamic Tag settings directory.
  • Update: UX updated with responsive category selector behavior.
  • Update: Tested compatibility and performed validation checks with latest Elementor.
  • Fixed: Performance optimizations for backend file and asset queries.

1.2.7

  • Added: Cookie dynamic tag wildcard pattern matching and dynamic standard options.
  • Added: Taxonomy availability checks to show Post Terms/Categories/Tags only on supported post types.
  • Fixed: Profile picture dynamic tags return standard Elementor image array structures.
  • Fixed: ACF/SCF Field tags automatically extract the first image when queried with gallery data.
  • Updated: Tag Directory database descriptions with comprehensive usage guides.
  • Fixed: Resolved PHPCS warnings across several core files.

1.2.6

  • Update: UI updated, security patch updated, and elementor compatibility check.

1.2.5

  • Added: Support forum integration directly linking to WordPress.org support forum.
  • Added: Spotlight notice announcing the release of Dynamic Tags for Elementor Pro.
  • Enhanced: Settings page layouts, security checks, and user experience.

1.2.4

  • Added: Freemius SDK integration for licensing, updates, and opt-in handling.
  • Added: Uninstall cleanup routine migrated to Freemius after_uninstall hook to clean up plugin data.
  • Fixed: Resolved concurrent plugin admin notice dismissal nonce collisions.
  • Enhanced: Tested compatibility up to Elementor 4.1.1 and Elementor Pro 4.1.0.

1.2.3

  • Added: Extensible filters dynatafo_dynamic_tag_groups and dynatafo_dynamic_tag_definitions to allow seamless tag and group registration from external plugins (e.g. the upcoming Pro add-on).
  • Added: Direct registration action hooks dynatafo_register_dynamic_tag_groups and dynatafo_register_dynamic_tags for third-party dynamic tags.
  • Added: Extensible actions dynatafo_admin_settings_before_content and dynatafo_admin_settings_after_content to dynamically output content (e.g. licensing tabs) directly inside the unified settings page.
  • Enhanced: Reinforced WooCommerce, ACF, and SCF compatibility layer to operate gracefully during activation and deactivation transitions.
  • Fixed: Version notice dismissal nonce collisions under concurrent plugin setups.

1.2.2

  • update: fixes dependencies with elementor latest version.

1.2.1

  • update: fixes dependencies with elementor latest version.

1.2.0

  • Added: Advanced caching and performance optimization system for significantly faster tag rendering.
  • Added: Request-scoped memoization for repeated field lookups (ACF, SCF) and WooCommerce product queries within single page render.
  • Added: Intelligent transient-based caching for admin-side file I/O with filemtime-based cache invalidation for tag directory and changelog parsing.
  • Added: Version-scoped admin notice manager with modular file-based notice definitions for extensible, maintainable release notifications.
  • Added: Two new dismissible admin notices: version-updated notice for release announcements and whats-new notice with feature highlights.
  • Enhanced: Improved performance for tag directory retrieval, changelog version parsing, and plugin dependency detection via persistent caching.
  • Improved: Reduced database queries and file system operations through SQL-free transient caching.
